executiveSummary: Harbor House's winter appeal tells one child's story, Maya's, who did her homework in a car for three months, to show a county-wide problem: one child in seven slept somewhere unstable last winter, and the wait for a family room has tripled since 2022. 212 families are waiting tonight. The appeal asks for $180,000 to keep every family room open from December to March.

slides.slideTitle: Every child deserves a warm bed this winter
slides.subtitle: Harbor House · Winter appeal 2026
slides.visualDescription: A child's bed with a patchwork quilt in a small, warm room
slides.speakerNotes: - Thank you all for coming tonight.

slides.slideTitle: Maya did her homework in a car for three months
keyBullets: Maya is nine. Last winter her family lost their apartment when her mother's hours were cut.
She slept in the back seat of a Corolla and did her spelling by the dome light.
She never missed a day of school.
slides.visualDescription: A girl doing homework in the back seat of a car at night, lit by a dome light
slides.speakerNotes:
- Maya's mother gave us permission to tell this story.
- Maya picked the photo herself.
slides.purpose: Puts one child's face on the problem
slides.intent: Make the audience care about one person first

keyBullets: 1 in 7
children in Halverson County slept somewhere unstable last winter
slides.speakerNotes:
- That's about 2,300 children.
- In a county most of you live in.

slides.subtitle: Average wait for a family room, days
keyBullets: The wait has tripled since 2022
slides.speakerNotes: - In 2022 a family waited 11 days. This year it's 34.

slides.slideTitle: “I didn't want her to know we were scared”
keyBullets: I didn't want her to know we were scared. Harbor House let me stop pretending.
Lena, Maya's mother
slides.visualDescription: A mother and daughter on a front porch at dusk, seen from behind
slides.speakerNotes: - Lena said this to me in March, the week they moved in.
slides.intent: Make the audience feel the fear and the relief

slides.slideTitle: This winter, 212 families are on our waiting list
slides.purpose: Names the gap tonight can close

keyBullets: $85: one night in a family room
$600: a month of after-school tutoring
$2,500: a family's first month of rent
$10,000: a room open all winter
slides.speakerNotes: - Every gift, any size, goes to a family on the list.

keyBullets: January: moved into a Harbor House family room
March: her mother started full-time work
June: the family signed a lease
September: Maya started fourth grade at the same school

keyBullets: We had a door that locked. That was everything. — Jamal, father of two
